item.title: Amazon Prime Air Drone Noise Draws Complaints from Texas Residents
item.description:
Amazon's Prime Air 30-minute drone delivery service in Texas communities has drawn resident complaints over noise likened to a swarm of bees, along with privacy concerns about navigation cameras and delivery mishaps. Amazon says delivery-phase noise is below an idling truck, has raised outbound flight altitude to 225 feet, and lets residents blur their homes on system maps.

原文标题：亚马逊 Prime Air 无人机噪音遭居民投诉

item.description:
Meta's AI agent Muse has launched a call-making feature that lets paying subscribers delegate calls to US businesses, insurers and DMV appointments using synthetic voice. After months of testing, it is now available to top-tier subscribers at $19.99 per month, though merchants often hang up upon recognizing the AI caller.

item.title: White House Superintelligence Task Force Shifts to Incentivize AI Safety Reporting
item.description:
The White House's newly formed Superintelligence Task Force has recommended that federal agencies limit regulatory liability for AI firms over cybersecurity incidents for the next 12 months, aiming to encourage voluntary disclosure of major safety events. The shift moves policy away from penalizing developers of unsafe products toward liability relief in exchange for transparency. The task force was established in late September amid rising public concern over runaway AI models.

原文标题：白宫超级智能工作组转向 鼓励 AI 企业主动报告安全事件

item.title: Nvidia VP Denies Resignation Letter as 84,000 Petition for Huang's Return
item.description:

The fake letter copied the OpenAI staff petition template, yet a separate online petition for Huang's return has gathered over 84,000 signatures, signaling lingering divisions after the leadership change.

item.title: Claude and Arduino Help 32-Year-Old Jeep Pass Emissions Test
item.description:
US AI enthusiast Mohammad Zulali used Claude for diagnosis and Codex for coding, paired with a $3 Arduino Nano, to read data from the aging engine computer of a 1994 Jeep Cherokee and tune fuel parameters until the 32-year-old vehicle passed California emissions testing. Total electronics cost under $15, and the project is open-sourced as xj-scanner under GPLv3.

原文标题：Claude 与 Arduino 联手让 32 年老车通过排放检测

Why it matters：一个具体可复现的 AI 辅助硬件逆向与诊断案例，展示了 LLM 在老旧系统改造中的实际价值。

item.title: Cursor Discloses Supply Chain Attack Affecting Up to 5,000 Users
item.description:
Cursor released its investigation into an October security incident in which attackers used leaked Fireworks keys to steal data from a shared storage bucket, then leveraged internal credentials to inject a tampered Claude Code extension into the Cursor marketplace. The malicious build stayed live for about 11 hours and affected up to 5,000 users; fewer than 0.05% of non-privacy-mode users had agent trace data exposed, and Cursor has notified affected customers and rotated credentials.

原文标题：Cursor 披露供应链攻击调查结果 最多波及 5000 用户

Why it matters：这是 AI 编程工具首次公开的完整供应链攻击复盘，对依赖扩展生态的开发者具有直接的安全警示价值。

item.title: Cloudflare Open-Sources Kitesurf Agent Browser With Lower Resource Use Than Chromium
item.description:
Cloudflare open-sourced Kitesurf on November 13, a browser built specifically for AI agents that runs on Cloudflare Workers and handles HTML parsing, CSS application, JavaScript execution and page screenshots without any Chromium process or container. Cloudflare says it targets agent-centric metrics such as token consumption, context window, scalability and cost, and consumes significantly less CPU and memory than Chromium on tasks like screenshots and HTML extraction, enabling higher-concurrency agent workloads.

原文标题：Cloudflare 开源智能体浏览器 Kitesurf 资源消耗低于 Chromium

item.title: Stanford-led Team Launches SPU Benchmark with 4,207 Wet-Lab Tests
item.description:
UniPat AI, together with Stanford, Harvard, Cornell and over ten other institutions, released Science Prediction Universe (SPU), a benchmark of 116 tasks and 4,207 real wet-lab experiments that tests whether AI can predict experimental outcomes before they are run. Models were given an H20 GPU and an 8-hour workday to autonomously use retrieval and compute resources, yet even Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra remained far from usable predictive accuracy, and a 5x compute increase did not help. The benchmark turns hard-to-quantify scientific judgment into a measurable, comparable score.

原文标题：斯坦福等发布 SPU 基准 4207 个湿实验考验 AI 预测

Why it matters：首个以真实湿实验结果为标尺的科研预测基准，揭示顶尖模型在科研判断上的真实差距。

item.title: Runway Open-Sources Praxis-1 Robot Control Model
item.description:
Runway has released Praxis-1, its robot control model, with open weights and source code under Apache 2.0. Trained on video and robot data, it maps camera images, text instructions and position data to robot motions, and can be adapted to new robot bodies via additional training. It still confuses similar-looking objects and cannot yet reliably plan complex action sequences on its own.

item.title: Nankai Team Proposes AI4AI Survey and L0-L3 Research Control Framework
item.description:
A joint survey from Nankai University and Zhongguancun Academy decomposes autonomous AI research into three key decisions: search direction, search space, and evaluation signal, and proposes an L0-L3 control-source framework accordingly. The framework measures how much research decision-making AI actually holds, rather than merely executing human-specified experiment plans.

item.title: Deepnote Benchmarks 12 AI Models as Slack Teammates, OpenAI Tops Cost-Efficiency
item.description:
Deepnote founder Jakub Jurovych released the Agent Initiative Benchmark, placing 12 frontier models into a shared corporate Slack channel as AI teammates to test whether they can judge when to intervene and when to stay silent. OpenAI took the top two spots: GPT-6 Astra scored 8.97 and GPT-6.1 Sol 8.65 at just $0.11 per task, while third-place Anthropic Fable 5.2 scored 8.17 at $1.87 per task, roughly 17x the cost for a lower score and about 16x higher monthly billing for a 70-person company. The widest gap: Fable 5.1 at $3.02 per task versus GPT-6 Luna at $0.007, a 430x price difference for only 1.1 points.

原文标题：12 个 AI 进群当同事，OpenAI 包揽前二且成本低 17 倍

Why it matters：首个以“AI 同事主动介入判断”为核心的真实协作场景评测，且给出极具冲击力的成本效益对比，对智能体落地选型有直接参考价值。
